evaluation: offline LongBench v2 field-pruning selector eligibility census
status: offline census only; no API calls; no remote reads; no result-quality inference

method.candidate_definition: full prompt exceeds target; default Sift compaction succeeds; field_pruning=True returns method=field_pruning_candidate; candidate meets target; candidate tokens are at most 110% of default Sift tokens
method.selector_probe: For every row, call core._field_pruned_root_source on the context and core._csv_complete_groups on the context plus explicit prompt, including rows already below target. These are the core candidate-path helpers.
method.compaction_scope: Run default and candidate compaction only for above-target rows with a direct root-JSON or explicit-CSV selector hit. All rows are still scanned and probed; non-hit/below-target compaction counts are null.
method.full_prompt_tokenization: Each distinct rendered full prompt is tokenizer-encoded once; subsequent core counts of that unchanged prompt use a SHA-256-keyed exact-count cache.
method.quality_note: This artifact measures selector-path structure, token fit, and eligibility only; it does not call a model or inspect answer keys.
